headline: Weathered Expanse Rages as Nevish and Mooring Stir
war_summary: Since last edition the Weathered Expanse has turned the ledger to six Warden, one Colonial and two unheld with eight changes in two hours and fifty-seven on the day about Wightwalk, Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, day losses near 9,810 Colonial and 12,941 Warden though hourly rates cool; the Nevish Line holds five Warden to three Colonial with five changes in two hours and twenty-one on the day about Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way, day losses about 4,057 Colonial and 5,132 Warden; Mooring County stands nine Warden, two Colonial and one unheld with two changes in two hours and seven on the day about MacConmara Barrows, fresh to the hour with day losses near 4,818 Colonial and 3,924 Warden; Callahan's Passage at nine Warden to one Colonial and Palantine Berm at seven Warden have fallen quiet in two hours after twenty-one and thirty-three changes on the day respectively, the former about Crumbling Post and the latter about The Droll, while Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row also report no changes in two hours.
